item.title: Trump Says AI Risks Are Manageable, Open to Regulatory Guardrails
item.description:
President Trump said AI risks are manageable and that he does not mind setting regulatory guardrails, signaling willingness to work with Democrats on oversight. The remark marks a shift from his earlier support for industry self-regulation and his dismissal of AI safety concerns as a hoax, though the extent of his openness remains unclear.

原文标题：特朗普称 AI 风险可控 对设置监管护栏持开放态度

Why it matters：美国 AI 监管风向可能出现边际变化，但仅有表态、缺乏具体政策细节，值得关注而非重点跟进。

item.title: LG AI Research Opens K-EXAONE 2.5 Model API for Free
item.description:
LG AI Research has made its K-EXAONE 2.5 model API freely available to developers, enterprises, and research institutions at no cost. The model, further trained from the August release, shows agentic capabilities on par with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and GLM-5.3 across AutomationBench, SWE-Bench Pro, BrowseComp, and Claw-Eval.

原文标题：LG AI 研究院免费开放 K-EXAONE 2.5 模型 API

Why it matters：免费开放 API 降低了使用门槛，且模型在多个智能体基准上对标头部开源模型，值得关注。

item.title: DeepMind Economist: Growth May Stay at 4-5% Even With Millions of AI Agents
item.description:
Alex Imas, Director of AGI Economics at Google DeepMind, argues that even with millions of autonomous AI agents, economic growth could remain in the 4-5% range. His core reasoning: GDP measures dollars spent rather than physical output, and when AI makes goods nearly free to produce, competition drives prices down, so output can explode while its dollar value barely grows, much like farming falling from ~40% to 2% of GDP after automation despite soaring food production.

原文标题：DeepMind 经济学家：即便有数百万 AI 智能体，经济增长仍可能停留在 4% 至 5%

Why it matters：来自 DeepMind 经济学负责人的反直觉判断，为 AI 生产力叙事提供了 GDP 度量视角的重要修正。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · industry · signal 58/100

item.title: Trump Says US Can't Finish Second to China in AI, Backs Guardrails
item.description:
In a 60 Minutes interview, President Trump said the US cannot afford to fall behind China in AI, voicing support for guardrails while warning against regulation that would drop America to second place. He claimed China has no guardrails. No concrete policy details were disclosed.

原文标题：特朗普称 AI 竞赛不能落后中国 但需保留护栏

Why it matters：这是 AI 地缘竞争与监管取向的高层表态，但缺乏具体政策内容，仅具信号意义。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · industry · signal 38/100

item.title: AMD CEO Lisa Su Says Meta Muse Hit 10M Users in 45 Days
item.description:
AMD CEO Lisa Su cited Meta's Muse as a standout example of rapid AI adoption, noting over 10 million activations in 45 days. She said annual operating plans that were once fixed now shift month to month because of AI adoption.

原文标题：AMD 苏姿丰谈 Meta Muse：45 天激活超千万用户

Why it matters：芯片巨头掌门人对 AI 采用速度的公开判断，可作为观察算力需求与产业节奏的参考。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · industry · signal 38/100

item.title: Cathie Wood Says Official Inflation Data Understates AI-Driven Software Price Deflation
item.description:
ARK Invest CEO Cathie Wood argues that AI training and inference costs are falling 75% to 99% annually, yet official inflation gauges such as CPI and PPI fail to capture how fast software prices are actually declining. The claim is a macro-level assertion without a disclosed methodology or data source.

原文标题：木头姐：官方通胀数据低估了 AI 压低软件价格的速度

Why it matters：这是知名投资人关于 AI 通缩效应的宏观观点，对关注 AI 产业经济影响的读者有参考价值，但缺乏可验证数据。

item.title: Cathie Wood: Power and Chip Shortages Force AI Efficiency Early
item.description:
ARK Invest CEO Cathie Wood argues that current shortages of power, chips and data-center capacity are pushing efficiency into AI earlier than expected. Drawing on the dot-com bubble's undisciplined spending, she expects this cycle to last longer and end with less fallout.

原文标题：木头姐：电力与芯片短缺正倒逼 AI 提前提升效率

Why it matters：知名投资人以稀缺约束视角解读 AI 资本周期，属观点类内容，无新增事实或数据。

item.title: Cathie Wood Blames Anthropic CEO for AI Backlash, Predicts Labor Shortage
item.description:
ARK Invest founder Cathie Wood publicly blamed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's warnings about AI extinction risk and mass job losses for fueling negative headlines, saying she disagrees with both and instead expects a labor shortage. The remarks are an industry opinion exchange without new data or verifiable evidence.

原文标题：木头姐批 Anthropic CEO 言论引发 AI 恐慌 称未来是劳动力短缺

Why it matters：反映 AI 风险叙事与乐观派之间的公开分歧，但仅为个人观点，无实质数据支撑。

item.title: Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron and SEMI Discuss Robot Charging Standardization for Fabs
item.description:
Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Micron are in talks with SEMI to standardize robot charging systems inside wafer fabs, forming an RX (Robot Transformation) alliance. The group will first ensure structural compatibility of charging equipment, then link robot battery data to fab manufacturing execution systems to coordinate work and charging schedules, addressing space constraints and fragmented charging specs in older fabs.

原文标题：三星、SK 海力士、美光与 SEMI 磋商晶圆厂机器人充电标准化

Why it matters：这是半导体制造自动化与机器人基础设施标准化的早期动向，虽处磋商阶段，但对晶圆厂智能化与机器人部署有长期影响。

item.title: Gurman: Apple May Launch Agentic Siri as Early as Next Year
item.description:
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports in Power On that Apple plans to ship an autonomous, agentic Siri as early as next year, shifting from command-response to proactively managing tasks and acting on the user's behalf against ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse and Grok. The report also says new CEO John Ternus has pressed software chief Craig Federighi to accelerate Apple's AI efforts.

原文标题：古尔曼：苹果最早明年推出代理式 Siri，可主动代用户完成任务

Why it matters：这是关于苹果智能体路线图的重要爆料，但缺乏具体参数、时间表细节与可验证材料，属于预告性质信息。

item.title: Artificial Analysis Releases Decision Index v2 with Calibrated Confidence Metric
item.description:
Artificial Analysis launched Decision Index v2, raising private-dataset coverage from 25% to 45% and introducing a Decision Score that rewards both correctness and calibrated confidence. Drex Max v1.1 leads narrowly at 73, just ahead of GLiDE v1.2 and Mammoth 27B, while GPT-6 Luna (Max) scores higher but costs $1,530 per 1M tasks and runs ~40x slower.

原文标题：Artificial Analysis 发布决策指数 v2 引入校准置信度新指标

Why it matters：第三方评测机构更新核心榜单方法论，直接影响模型选型与基准可信度判断。

item.title: Opinion: The AI Bubble Narrative May Be Overstated
item.description:
The author argues that despite at least $3 trillion in spending commitments and opaque financing vehicles, the assumption that an AI bubble must pop is not well founded, and rapid growth may still be justified. The piece is opinion analysis without new verifiable data or quantitative modeling.

原文标题：观点：AI 泡沫论或许站不住脚

Why it matters：提供对 AI 泡沫争论的反向视角，适合关注行业估值与资本开支的读者参考。

item.title: Stanford and DeepMind's TURTLE Evolves Tool-Use Benchmarks to Stay Hard
item.description:
A new Stanford and Google DeepMind paper introduces TURTLE, which uses AlphaEvolve to mutate saturated tool-use tasks from AppWorld by adding filters, extra steps and hidden lookups, targeting roughly 50% solver success. Gemma 4 31B-it always solved 69% of original tasks, while nearly all 735 evolved tasks landed at 40%-60% completion, and an LLM judge rated 52.5% of evolved tasks hard versus 19.8% of originals.

原文标题：斯坦福与 DeepMind 提出 TURTLE 自动进化工具调用基准

Why it matters：提出一种可复用的基准自动进化范式，直接回应工具调用评测饱和问题，对关注模型评测与智能体的读者有实操价值。

item.title: Tencent Yuanqi Agent Platform Shuts Down, Data Export Ends January 2027
item.description:
Tencent's one-stop agent platform Yuanqi officially shut down all public services on November 9, disabling agents published to WeChat official accounts and customer service channels. Users must export data before January 9, 2027, after which Tencent will delete all user data, with the company directing users to its Cloud Agent Development Platform (ADP) and official-account auto-reply features.

原文标题：腾讯元器正式停服 明年 1 月起停止受理数据导出

Why it matters：大厂智能体平台退场，反映智能体分发赛道的整合与洗牌，对关注 Agent 生态的读者有参考价值。

item.title: KetchUp Launches Open-Source SketchUp Alternative Built on Rust and WebGPU
item.description:
KetchUp is a free, open-source 3D modeling app for woodworking and furniture design, written in Rust and rendered with WebGPU, running on Windows, macOS, Linux and desktop browsers with no account required. It targets precise dimensioned planning of shelves, tables and cabinets as a lightweight SketchUp alternative, though textures, scenes and some model features are unsupported and OBJ export omits materials.

原文标题：KetchUp 发布 Rust 与 WebGPU 打造的开源 SketchUp 替代品

Why it matters：这是 WebGPU 与 Rust 在桌面级 3D 建模工具中的一次实用落地，对关注开源图形工具链的开发者有参考价值。

item.title: Building a SQLite parse_number Extension in C vs Rust
item.description:
Simon Willison used Claude to compare implementing a SQLite parse_number() custom function in C versus Rust: the C extension was only 14 KB while the Rust builds were around 300 KB, yet Rust ran faster because its float parsing is roughly twice as fast as C's strtod. He then explored writing a faster hand-rolled C parser and packaged the investigation as a reproducible research report.

原文标题：用 C 与 Rust 编写 SQLite parse_number 扩展对比

Why it matters：以具体体积与性能数据展示 C 与 Rust 编写 SQLite 扩展的取舍，对扩展开发者有直接参考价值。

Simon Willison 博客 · tools · signal 42/100

item.title: Stanford's AI-Native Engineering Course Teaches Agent-Driven Workflows
item.description:
Stanford lecturer Mihail Eric walks through his Modern Software Developer syllabus, which trains engineers to ship software and debug outages with coding agents rather than treat AI as autocomplete. He also shares which parts of the curriculum survived contact with his own AI team at Monaco.

原文标题：斯坦福开设 AI 原生工程课 教开发者用智能体重构工作流

Why it matters：对关心工程师技能转型与智能体落地实践的读者有参考价值，但属访谈观点而非可验证的新技术发布。

item.title: SafeScript Launches as Safe JavaScript Subset for Untrusted Code Execution
item.description:
SafeScript is a strict, safe subset of JavaScript that strips eval, new, globals and prototype access, compiling to plain JS and PHP with a ~48 KB minified (~12 KB gzipped) compiler. It targets webserver handlers, event callbacks, plugin scripts, formulas and AI agent tools, letting user-submitted logic run safely inside a sandbox.

原文标题：SafeScript 发布：可安全执行不可信代码的 JavaScript 子集

Why it matters：为不可信代码提供可本地验证的轻量安全执行层，对智能体工具与插件生态有直接实用价值。

Hacker News AI · tools · signal 62/100

item.title: Amazon Paper Finds Rule-Following AI Benchmarks Riddled with Answer-Key and Scorer Bugs
item.description:
A new Amazon paper audited nine public rule-following benchmarks such as RuleArena and LegalBench and found that their reference answers and grading code contain errors, causing correct model responses to be marked wrong. In LegalBench's tax scorer, decimal points were stripped, turning $259,487.13 into 25,948,713; after the fix, three models' accepted answers rose from 8-9 out of 96 to 87-91. The authors urge checking scorer code and hand-reviewing failed answers before trusting low scores.

原文标题：亚马逊论文发现规则类基准答案键与评分代码普遍出错

Why it matters：该研究揭示规则类基准的评分缺陷会系统性低估模型能力，直接影响对模型评测结论的信任。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 71/100

item.title: Stanford CS146S Has Students Pitch Real Patches to Open-Source Maintainers
item.description:
With coding agents able to finish last year's homework in a single prompt, Stanford's CS146S now requires students to learn an unfamiliar open-source repo, propose a change, and defend the patch to the maintainer who might merge it. Instructor Mihail Eric, who also leads AI at Monaco, walks through the syllabus and explains how his team decides which agent tooling to build versus buy, including on-call agents wired into Datadog and GitHub.

原文标题：斯坦福 CS146S 课程：让学生向开源维护者提交真实补丁

Why it matters：提供了一个可借鉴的 AI 原生工程教学范式，以及企业自建与采购智能体工具的决策视角。

Latent Space · agent · signal 42/100

item.title: Nvidia Board Opens Independent Probe Into Reported Foreign Intelligence Targeting of Jensen Huang
item.description:
Nvidia's board said it is launching an independent investigation following reports that founder and CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort, overseen by a committee of independent directors with outside counsel. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, and Huang supports and will cooperate with the review. The probe touches governance and geopolitical risk at the world's key AI compute supplier, though no substantive evidence has been disclosed.

原文标题：英伟达董事会启动独立调查 审查黄仁勋遭外国情报瞄准报道

Why it matters：全球 AI 算力核心供应商的最高管理层遭遇安全审查，牵动供应链与地缘风险判断，值得持续关注。

item.title: 用 Git 队列管理 AI 编码会话 缓解上下文过载
item.description:
作者针对在终端使用 Claude Code 与 Codex 时多线程并行导致的“大脑过载”问题，提出把任务组织成类似优先队列的工作流：每个任务以 Markdown 文件形式存放在代码仓库中，看板状态作为提交快照保存，从而把任务排序与上下文从聊天窗口和记忆中剥离出来。该方案属于个人实践经验分享，未提供量化数据或可复用工具。

Why it matters：对重度使用终端 AI 编码代理的开发者有实操参考价值，但属个人经验分享，缺乏数据与工具化产出。

item.title: 纽约时报称中国招募 AI 高管接近黄仁勋获取芯片情报
item.description:
《纽约时报》援引一份在特朗普政府高级官员间传阅的备忘录称，美国情报部门认定与黄仁勋关系密切的华裔高管 Alice Huang 为北京情报资产，其公司 Megaspeed 自 2024 年起大举采购英伟达芯片，并通过向阿里巴巴出租东南亚数据中心算力形成受限芯片的迂回通道。该指控目前仅基于匿名备忘录，尚无公开证据或当事方回应，事实强度有限，但涉及英伟达、出口管制与中美科技博弈，产业关注度高。

Why it matters：涉及英伟达、出口管制与中美芯片博弈的重磅指控，虽证据薄弱但产业影响面广，值得关注后续进展。

item.title: 苹果加速推进 Siri 智能体化 追赶 OpenAI 与 Meta
item.description:
彭博社 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果 CEO John Ternus 正施压 AI 负责人 Craig Federighi 加快 Siri 路线图，目标是打造能与 OpenAI Dots、Meta Muse 竞争的 AI 智能体。近期两项升级已明确：iOS 27.3 将赋予 Siri 对苹果第一方应用的细粒度控制（如裁剪旋转照片、整理 Safari 标签页），第三方应用集成预计明年春季落地，支持通过 Grubhub 下单、OpenTable 订餐。更长远的目标是让 Siri 具备持续执行多步任务的能力，最早明年实现。

Why it matters：苹果智能体路线图与时间表首次具体化，是观察消费级 AI 助手竞争格局的关键信号。

The Verge AI · agent · signal 62/100

item.title: DeepSeek 开源智能体 Harness 日活破 154 万
item.description:
DeepSeek 开源智能体应用 Harness 上线不到三个月，官方 API 用户日活已达 154 万，较 9 月底的 7 日均值 27.1 万大幅增长。这些用户每天消耗约 92 万亿 token，人均约 6000 万，显示长时间运行的智能体任务算力消耗远超聊天机器人。Harness 采用全插件化架构，已积累约 3.5 万个用户插件，官方下一步将推出插件市场与创作者激励计划。

Why it matters：这是智能体应用规模化与算力消耗模式的早期公开数据，对判断 Agent 生态竞争格局有参考价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · agent · signal 78/100

item.title: 清华与月之暗面发布 TCSExam：GPT-6 Astra 证明 70% 定理却解不出开放猜想
item.description:
清华大学与月之暗面联合发布 TCSExam 基准，包含 100 项专家评审任务，覆盖 Lean 定理证明、求解器工程、破纪录构造与 30 个开放猜想四大方向，所有提交均由 Lean 内核或任务检查器验证。结果显示，GPT-6 Astra 在无提示引理条件下完整证明率达 70.0%，Kimi K3.1 Pro 为 38.3%，其余 6 个智能体最高仅 11.7%；但在 30 个理论计算机科学开放猜想上，同一模型全部失败，少数被接受的提交也只是改编了 OpenAI 已公开的反例与证明。

Why it matters：该基准首次把机器可验证的定理证明与真正未解的开放猜想放在同一评测框架下，清晰划出当前模型在“复现已知证明”与“创造新数学”之间的能力鸿沟。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon 宣称 SOTA 却全渠道不可用
item.description:
开发者 Yuchen Jin 指出，谷歌上月发布的 Gemini 4 Carbon 虽在 Artificial Analysis 榜单排名第一，但免费、Pro、Ultra 及 API 渠道均无法使用。该帖仅陈述可用性缺失，未提供模型参数、发布时间表或官方回应等实质信息。

item.title: 高盛限制交易员与银行家使用 Claude Code 仅工程师保留权限
item.description:
高盛在 10 月更新内部指引，将 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 与微软 GitHub 的使用权限收窄至工程师群体，交易员与投资银行家被切断访问。此前这些人员曾用该工具追踪客户交易流、构建市场与持仓模型。高盛同时是 Anthropic IPO 的联席主承销商，并已于 4 月禁止香港银行家使用 Claude。

Why it matters：头部投行对 AI 编码工具的实际权限收缩，折射出金融业在生产力与合规风险之间的真实取舍。

item.title: DeepSeek 称 Harness 要做 Agent 时代的操作系统
item.description:
DeepSeek 团队成员田一（Tianyi Cui）回应插件作者疑问时表示，DeepSeek Harness 的定位是“Agent 时代的操作系统”：官方只提供稳定的基础能力与通用内置功能，并坚持“一切皆插件”的设计，内置功能也可被第三方插件替换，鼓励社区作品成为用户日常选择。该表态明确了 Harness 的插件生态边界与开放策略，但未披露具体 API、版本或时间表。

Why it matters：这是 DeepSeek 官方首次系统阐述 Harness 的插件生态定位，对关注 Agent 平台与插件开发的读者有参考价值，但目前仅为理念表态，缺少可验证的技术细节。
